description: This file defines a utility class CatalogContextSeed responsible for seeding initial data into a database context in an e-commerce application. It includes methods for populating catalog brands, types, and items, with retry logic for transient failures.

classes.name: CatalogContextSeed
classes.description: A static class providing methods to seed initial catalog data into the database context.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds catalog brands, types, and items into the database, with retry logic for transient errors.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined catalog brand entities.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined catalog type entities.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredItems
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined catalog item entities.
